newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn basis off, harvest picks-up.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn basis off, harvest picks-up.

text.p: FOB corn basis values were lower on Wednesday as newly harvested supplies began increasingly to move into the export pipeline, dealers said.
"It appears a little more corn is getting into the pipeline," one dealer said.
Soybean basis values remained little changed.
Wheat basis values remained steady as dealers discounted the threat that Argentine wheat could be imported into the U.S.
"It just won't happen. The mills will not take the wheat as they are afraid of bad press (media coverage). It is not a quality thing -- it is a political thing," one dealer said.
They estimated Argentine wheat could be shipped to the U.S. Gulf for around $155.00 per ton, about $30.00 less than the cost of U.S. hard red winter wheat.
